body:
Marijuana is addictive
I have been smoking pot for 4 years and am now 21.  When I first started, I was smoking 3-4 bowls a week.  4 years later, I'm smoking 2.5g/day (5-6 bowls a day).  They say marijuana is not addictive-physically, but it sure as hell is psychologically addictive.
I have been straight now for 2 days, (I know that this is not a long time) and am having a very hard time with the cravings.  Life seems very dull without it and I am resorting to benzodiapines in order to  curb the psychological withdrawal.  I know that the benzos are physically addictive, so I am doing this under the care of a psychiatrist.
I have enjoyed my time using marijuana immensely, but I know that it is time to grow up and stop.  I can't afford a $40/day habit and I have also withdrawn socially.  There are many positives that have occured while using, but my continuation will only lead to more difficulties.  I have been diagnosed as bipolar, and part of the reason I began to use was to self medicate.  I have used all sorts of drugs in my life; cannibis, amphetimines, ecstacy, opiates, coke, benzos, you name it.  The only one though that I have had a difficult time stopping is the pot.  (Possibly because I am used to being high from dawn til dusk.
Life is much better sober.
